criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3, 9 and 7 meet the bold standard and 5 reads at feed size on a mid band. 6 a pale boxy peaker a fifth of the frame wide on streaked ground; 2 a flat outline on a uniform plane with a channel band that reads as no object; 4 a flat-shaded ruler in the bottom fifth; 1's sign evenly front-lit with casts hard to find.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world, dark throughout, the green with one meaning, the sign bookend and the line motif working, the declared value cut at 7. 2 sits outside the deck and 6's ground breaks the stock.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traced and quotes match. The cover joins c3's site to c9 and c14's de-annexed land; the de-annexation half rests on the Tribune; the 109 juxtaposition invites a reading the sources don't make, though labelled.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Body, county, decision and deadline named, with the way to be heard. The Saturday vote has no month, and the abatement's size or term is not addressed.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 7 turns to action. 8 carries Brownsville's voices over Starbase's lectern and 9 repeats 7's logistics.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Texan openers, honest on costs. 7's last sentence is redundant, 5 dates by the newspaper, 'the Tribune reports' recurs.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat. No. 61 drew a city limit sign and staked pad and no. 62 survey stakes, a parcel drawn to area and a night close within 16 days; lastLight again.

one_sentence_fix: Keep 444 acres with the notice's project site rather than the de-annexed land, give the Saturday vote its month, and say whether the notice states the abatement's size.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: pale stacked boxes a fifth of the frame wide on streaked ground
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pull in until the peaker fills a third of the width, side-light from the left with a long cast right, slide 5's ground and scatter

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: a flat outline on a uniform plane, the channel reads as no object
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: eye about 250 m with the horizon in the top fifth, pool the near corner, saltgrass casts, dark water with a lit riprap bank

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: a flat-shaded ruler in the bottom fifth under empty crust
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: camera about 0.5 m, lath diagonal through the middle third, grain, wet clay foot, limp ribbon, key raking the hole's lip
